subject: Kestrel preboarding: consolidated screening & training manifest
messages:
From: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@kestrel.health>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preboarding evidence request for upcoming audit

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing for a focused SOC 2 readiness review next month and need a compact set of preboarding artifacts that demonstrate your personnel controls for new hires and temporary contractors. Specifically, can you provide the following for a sample cohort (20 people):

- Redacted background-check confirmations (date + scope, redacted PII)
- Training completion records (security awareness, data handling) with dates
- Onboarding/offboarding playbook excerpts showing access provisioning and deprovisioning steps
- A manifest (CSV) mapping employee IDs, role, hire date, and sample evidence file names
- Proof of credential revocation (audit log screenshots or export) for several offboards in 2025–2026

We prefer a secure Drive folder or SFTP share. Timeline: would you be able to deliver a consolidated pack by July 14? If there are sensitive items you cannot share, please indicate equivalents (screenshots, audit summaries, or attestations).

Please copy your security contact on any notes about redaction.

Best,
Ava Thomson
Security Program Manager
Kestrel Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thomson <ava.thomson@kestrel.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preboarding evidence request for upcoming audit

Hi Ava — thanks for the detailed ask. We'll assemble a compact "preboarding integrity manifest" that matches the items you listed. Proposed plan:

1) We will produce a CSV manifest mapping internal IDs -> role -> hire date -> filenames.
2) Provide redacted background-check confirmations (scanned PDFs with PII redacted).
3) Training roster CSV with completion timestamps and course versions.
4) Export of access deprovision events (CSV + a couple of redacted screenshots).
5) Short attestations where full documents can't be exported (e.g., vendor background vendors with NDAs).

Marissa / Rishi — can you confirm who will pull the HR checks and run the redaction pass? We need to make sure contractor records are included and that we redact SSNs, DOB, and personal addresses.

Ava — Drive or SFTP both work; we'll upload to a secure folder and share a read-only link. Target delivery: initially by end-of-day Fri, July 9 (so you have time before your July 14 window). If any items need more time we'll flag them immediately.

Attachment plan: we'll include the manifest CSV and the redacted PDFs; originals stay in HR and won't be shared.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Grace — I'll take the lead on pulling the HR verification artifacts and doing the redaction sweep. Notes for the pack:

- HR system export for 2024–2026 contractor and employee screening is available; I will extract the verification stamps and run a script to redact PII fields (SSN, DOB, home address).
- For police/court checks we typically have a confirmation stamp PDF with vendor metadata; I'll include the vendor name + verification date and redact candidate personal details per Kestrel guidance.
- Training completions live in the LMS. I'll export the roster and include course ID/version and completion timestamps.
- For deprovision proofs: I'll export the privileged access audit log for the last 12 months and include a CSV with event timestamps; screenshots will be redacted to remove internal hostnames.

Grace — will you create the Drive folder and toggle DLP restrictions? I can upload on Friday morning and let you know when the redaction pass is complete.

-Marissa
